title: Happy Diwali from Prathamesh
description: A Diwali greeting from Prathamesh, best with the sound on. Tap the diya to light it and watch the flame spread from lamp to lamp across a courtyard at night: a rangoli draws itself on the stone, a sky lantern lifts off, and fireworks climb over the rooftops to write the wish in the sky. Tap the sky for more fireworks, then watch it again.

onboarding.message: Turn the sound on, then tap the diya to light it.
